Fuck… I knew this would happen…
You: Nothing bad, really. 
Bot: We need to stop the bleeding!
You: It already stopped by itself. Don’t worry about it. I will clean myself up and be good as new.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.VeryAngry
Bot: Who did this?! They are done for!

#bot.Expression.VerySad
You: It was entirely my fault. I was in a bad state of mind.
You: Everything is alright now, so cheer up a little, ok?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Ok…
